clauses.heading: FIRST AMENDMENT TO SENIOR REVOLVER LOAN AGREEMENT
clauses.text: THIS FIRST AMENDMENT TO SENIOR REVOLVER LOAN AGREEMENT, dated effective as of March 27, 2019 (the "First Amendment"), is entered into by and among EMPIRE LOUISIANA LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the "Original Borrower" or "EL") and EMPIRE NORTH DAKOTA LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("END", together with the Original Borrower are sometimes referred to herein collectively as the "Borrower") and CROSSFIRST BANK, a Kansas state-chartered bank (the "Bank").
clauses.plain_english: This clause identifies the parties involved in the First Amendment to the Senior Revolver Loan Agreement, specifically naming Empire Louisiana LLC and Empire North Dakota LLC as the Borrowers and CrossFirst Bank as the Bank, effective as of March 27, 2019.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard introductory clause identifying the parties and the effective date of the amendment. It carries no inherent risk.

clauses.heading: 1. Definitions. Capitalized terms used herein and not otherwise
clauses.text:
"Guaranty Agreement" means that certain Amended and Restated Guaranty Agreement of even date herewith, from Guarantor, in favor of Bank, in form, scope and substance acceptable to Bank.
"Revolver Commitment Amount" shall be the maximum outstanding principal amount plus Letter of Credit Exposure the Bank agrees from time to time to make available under the Revolver Commitment (initially stipulated to be equal to $9,000,000.00), subject to the QCR.
"Revolver Final Maturity Date" shall mean March 27, 2021, unless otherwise extended or renewed in writing by the mutual agreement of the Borrower and the Bank.
"QCR" shall have the meaning given in Section 2.13 of the Loan Agreement.
clauses.plain_english: This clause defines key terms used in the agreement, specifically the Guaranty Agreement, the Revolver Commitment Amount (capped at $9,000,000), the Revolver Final Maturity Date (March 27, 2021), and the QCR.
clauses.risk_justification: These are standard definitions used to clarify the scope and maturity of the loan facility. No unusual or high-risk obligations are created by the definitions themselves.

clauses.heading: 2. Revolver Commitment. The Revolver Commitment is hereby increa
clauses.text: sed and renewed to the Revolver Final Maturity Date, subject to the Revolver Commitment Amount, the Collateral Borrowing Base limitations and QCR described below. All of the Indebtedness created pursuant thereto is evidenced by that certain replacement Promissory Note (Revolver Note) dated as of March 27, 2019, from the Borrower payable to the order of the Bank in the maximum principal amount of $20,000,000.00 (subject to the Revolver Commitment Amount and the Collateral Borrowing Base). The Revolver Commitment Amount and the Collateral Borrowing Base are stipulated to be set at $9,000,000.00 as of the effective date of this First Amendment, which increase shall be in accordance with and satisfy the Collateral Borrowing Base Redeterminations under Section 4.2 of the Loan Agreement for April 2019.
clauses.plain_english: The Revolver Commitment is increased and extended until the maturity date, subject to specific borrowing base limits. The total debt is evidenced by a replacement promissory note for up to $20,000,000.00, with the current commitment amount set at $9,000,000.00 as of the amendment date.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard amendment clause adjusting loan commitment amounts and referencing existing promissory notes. The terms are specific and tied to existing loan agreement mechanisms.
obligations: Borrower must repay indebtedness evidenced by the replacement Promissory Note
Borrower must adhere to Collateral Borrowing Base limitations and QCR
rights: Borrower is entitled to a Revolver Commitment amount of $9,000,000.00 subject to borrowing base limitations

clauses.heading: 2.4 Loan Origination Fee. Borrower shall pay to Bank a fully earn
clauses.text: ed and non-refundable loan origination fee equal to $76,900.00 (one hundred basis points (1.00%) on the $7,690,000.00 increase in the Revolver Commitment Amount).
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower is required to pay the Bank a non-refundable fee of $76,900.00, which represents 1% of the $7,690,000.00 increase in the Revolver Commitment Amount.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard, clearly defined, one-time fee associated with an increase in credit commitment. The amount is fixed and the trigger is explicit.
obligations: Borrower shall pay to Bank a fully earned and non-refundable loan origination fee equal to $76,900.00

clauses.heading: Payment of Fees. All fees payable under Sections 2.4, 2.5, 2.
clauses.text: 2.10 and 2.14 shall be paid on the dates due, in immediately available funds, US Dollars, to Bank and shall be fully earned and non-refundable under any circumstances.
clauses.plain_english: Fees required under specific sections of the agreement must be paid to the Bank on their due dates using immediately available US Dollars. Once paid, these fees are considered fully earned by the Bank and cannot be refunded for any reason.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause mandates payment in immediately available funds and includes a 'non-refundable under any circumstances' provision, which is standard in loan agreements but creates a firm financial obligation for the Borrowers without recourse.
obligations: Pay fees under Sections 2.4, 2.5, 2.10, and 2.14 to the Bank on the dates due
Ensure payment is made in immediately available US Dollars
rights: Bank's right to receive non-refundable fees

clauses.heading: Quarterly Commitment Reduction
clauses.text: 5. Quarterly Commitment Reduction. The following replaces Section 2.13 of the Existing Loan Agreement in its entirety:
clauses.plain_english: This clause serves as an amendment to replace the existing Section 2.13 of the original loan agreement with new terms regarding the reduction of commitment amounts on a quarterly basis.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a procedural amendment clause that replaces a section of the original agreement. It does not contain substantive financial or legal obligations on its own, but rather facilitates the update of the contract terms.

clauses.heading: 2.13 Quarterly Commitment Reduction (QCR). On the last day of each
clauses.text: calendar quarter, commencing June 30, 2019, the Revolver Commitment Amount shall automatically be reduced by $150,000.00 per quarter (the "QCR"), and Borrower shall make any principal payment necessary to comply with the QCR. Such principal payment shall be in addition to the regularly scheduled interest payment. The definition of "MCR" and all references to "MCR" in the Existing Loan Agreement are hereby deleted.
clauses.plain_english: Starting June 30, 2019, the total amount the Bank is committed to lend will decrease by $150,000 every quarter. The Borrower is required to make principal payments to match these reductions, which are separate from regular interest payments. Additionally, the term 'MCR' is removed from the original loan agreement.
clauses.risk_justification: This clause imposes a mandatory, recurring principal reduction obligation on the Borrower, which increases liquidity pressure. While standard in revolving credit facilities, it represents a firm financial obligation that must be met regardless of the Borrower's cash flow status.
obligations: Borrower shall make any principal payment necessary to comply with the QCR on the last day of each calendar quarter commencing June 30, 2019.
deadlines: Last day of each calendar quarter, commencing June 30, 2019

clauses.heading: 2.14 Loan Amendment Fee. For each amendment or other change to
clauses.text: this Agreement that is required (in the sole discretion of the Bank) as a result of a change in terms or conditions requested by Borrower, Borrower shall pay Bank a fee in an amount equal to the Revolver Commitment Amount then outstanding, multiplied by twenty five basis points (0.25%), which fee shall be payable in immediately available funds concurrent with the closing of such amendment.
clauses.plain_english: If the Borrower requests a change to the loan agreement and the Bank agrees to it, the Borrower must pay the Bank a fee equal to 0.25% of the outstanding Revolver Commitment Amount at the time the amendment is closed.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause imposes a mandatory fee based on a percentage of the total commitment amount upon the Borrower's request for an amendment. While standard in commercial lending, the fee is calculated on the total commitment rather than the actual usage, which can be costly for the Borrower.
obligations: Borrower shall pay Bank a fee equal to the Revolver Commitment Amount then outstanding multiplied by 0.25% upon the closing of an amendment requested by the Borrower.
rights: Bank has the right to receive a fee for amendments requested by the Borrower.
deadlines: payable in immediately available funds concurrent with the closing of such amendment

clauses.heading: 7. Financial Statements and Reports. Section 6.6(a) and the firs
clauses.text: 6.6(b) of the Existing Loan Agreement are hereby modified to provide that the Guarantor will furnish such Financial Statements and Reports pursuant to the terms of the Guaranty Agreement.
clauses.plain_english: This clause updates the existing loan agreement to specify that the Guarantor must provide financial statements and reports as required by the separate Guaranty Agreement.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard administrative amendment clarifying the reporting obligations of the Guarantor by referencing an existing document (the Guaranty Agreement). It does not impose new, unusual, or onerous burdens.
obligations: Guarantor must furnish Financial Statements and Reports pursuant to the terms of the Guaranty Agreement

clauses.heading: 8. Net Lease Operating Reports. The following replaces Section 6
clauses.text: (c) Net Lease Operating Reports. No later than sixty (60) days after the end of each calendar quarter, reports regarding leases in the same form as they are received by the operator under each applicable operators agreement.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower must provide the Bank with copies of lease reports within 60 days after the end of every calendar quarter, using the same format the operator receives them in.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard reporting obligation common in loan agreements to ensure the lender has visibility into the collateral's performance. The 60-day window is reasonable.
obligations: Provide reports regarding leases to the Bank no later than sixty (60) days after the end of each calendar quarter.
deadlines: No later than sixty (60) days after the end of each calendar quarter

clauses.heading: Section 28 (Minimum Leverage Ratio) and Section 29 (Minimum
clauses.text:
Interest Coverage
Ratio) of the Existing Loan Agreement shall be measured for Borrower on a combined
basis using consolidated financial statements provided by the Guarantor.
clauses.plain_english: The financial ratios (Interest Coverage Ratio and Minimum Leverage Ratio) required under the loan agreement must be calculated by combining the financial results of the Borrowers and using the consolidated financial statements provided by the Guarantor.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard accounting and reporting methodology clause for consolidated loan agreements. It clarifies how financial covenants are calculated, which is standard practice in multi-entity loan structures.
obligations: Borrower must measure Interest Coverage Ratio and Minimum Leverage Ratio on a combined basis
Borrower must use consolidated financial statements provided by the Guarantor for these measurements

clauses.heading: 10. Collateral/Mortgages. The term "Collateral" as that term is d
clauses.text: efined in Article III of the Existing Loan Agreement shall incorporate and include, without limitation, all real and personal property lien interests granted by END to Bank by the following: (i) mortgage liens or deeds of trust (as applicable) encumbering END's proved producing and proved non-producing oil, gas and other leasehold and mineral interests (including, without limitation, behind-the pipe values), on a first priority basis, including without limitation, those properties situated in the States of North Dakota and Montana (the "END Mortgages"), and (ii) a first priority security interest in substantially all of END's personal property according to the terms of a certain Pledge, Security Agreement and Assignment instrument dated as even date with this First Amendment, in form and substance satisfactory to Bank (the "END Security Agreement"). The term "Mortgages" as that term is defined in Article III of the Existing Loan Agreement shall incorporate and include the END Mortgages.
clauses.plain_english: This clause expands the definition of 'Collateral' and 'Mortgages' under the existing loan agreement to include specific oil, gas, and mineral interests in North Dakota and Montana, as well as a first-priority security interest in the borrower's personal property as defined in a new security agreement.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard collateral expansion clause in a loan amendment. While it increases the assets pledged to the Bank, it is typical for secured lending transactions and does not introduce unusual or unconscionable burdens.
obligations: Grant first priority mortgage liens or deeds of trust on proved producing and non-producing oil, gas and mineral interests
Grant a first priority security interest in substantially all personal property pursuant to the END Security Agreement
rights: Bank is granted first priority lien interests in the specified real and personal property
cross_references: Article III of the Existing Loan Agreement

clauses.heading: 11. Amended Louisiana Mortgage. EL, as mortgagor, and CrossFirst,
clauses.text: as mortgagee, are parties to a certain Mortgage, Assignment of As-Extracted Collateral, Security Agreement and Fixture Filing dated as of September 20, 2018, as corrected by instrument dated November 7, 2018, whereby EL granted a first priority mortgage lien and security interest in all of its oil and gas leases, leasehold interests, and related assets located in the State of Louisiana (the "Original Louisiana Mortgage"). As a condition precedent to CrossFirst's obligations under this First Amendment, CrossFirst requires that the Original Louisiana Mortgage be amended and modified to incorporate and secure repayment of all amounts extended under and evidenced by the increased Revolver Commitment, all according to the terms of a certain First Amendment to Mortgage, Assignment of As-Extracted Collateral, Security Agreement and Fixture Filing dated on or about the date of the First Amendment (the "Amended Louisiana Mortgage").
clauses.plain_english: This clause establishes that as a condition for the Bank to increase the loan commitment, the Borrower must amend the existing Louisiana mortgage to ensure it covers the new, higher loan amount.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard condition precedent in a loan amendment, requiring the borrower to update security documentation to reflect increased debt obligations.
obligations: EMPIRE LOUISIANA LLC must amend and modify the Original Louisiana Mortgage to incorporate and secure repayment of all amounts extended under the increased Revolver Commitment.
rights: CROSSFIRST BANK has the right to require the amendment of the Original Louisiana Mortgage as a condition precedent to its obligations under the First Amendment.

clauses.heading: 12. Conditions Precedent. The Borrower shall execute and deliver,
clauses.text: or cause to be executed and delivered, to the Bank, each of the following as express conditions precedent to the effectiveness of the amendments and modifications contemplated by this First Amendment: ( This First Amendment; a ) ( The replacement Promissory Note (Revolver Note); b ) ( The END Mortgages; c ) ( The END Security Agreements; d ) ( The Amended Louisiana Mortgage; e ) ( The Guaranty Agreement; f ) ( The obligation of Borrower to furnish the Bank with appropriate g certificates from the State of North Dakota that demonstrate END is registered and qualified to do business in the State of North Dakota, shall be an express condition subsequent and must be accomplished by Borrower to the Bank's satisfaction no later than April 12, 2019, and failure of Borrower to timely satisfy such condition subsequent shall constitute an Event of Default hereunder without further or other notice from the Bank. ) ( Payment to the Bank of the fully earned and non-refundable one percent (1.0%) loan origination fee in the amount of $76,900.00 h concurrently herewith in immediately available funds (US Dollars); and ) ( Closing certificates from each of the Borrowers. i )
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower must deliver several documents and make a payment of $76,900.00 to the Bank as conditions for the amendment to take effect. Additionally, the Borrower must provide proof of business registration in North Dakota by April 12, 2019; failure to do so will result in an immediate Event of Default.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause imposes an immediate Event of Default for failure to satisfy a condition subsequent (North Dakota registration) by a specific date without further notice, creating significant operational risk for the Borrower.
obligations: Execute and deliver First Amendment
Execute and deliver replacement Promissory Note
Execute and deliver END Mortgages
Execute and deliver END Security Agreements
Execute and deliver Amended Louisiana Mortgage
Execute and deliver Guaranty Agreement
Furnish Bank with certificates of registration for North Dakota by April 12, 2019
Pay $76,900.00 loan origination fee
Deliver closing certificates
rights: Bank's right to declare an Event of Default upon failure to meet the North Dakota registration condition

clauses.heading: 13. Fees and Expenses. Borrower shall promptly (in any event with
clauses.text: in ten (10) days of receipt of an invoice therefor) reimburse the Bank for its reasonable legal fees and all filing and recording fees and other costs and expenses reasonably incurred in connection with the negotiation, preparation and closing of the transactions contemplated by this First Amendment, including the reasonable attorney fees and costs and expenses of Bank's legal counsel and any applicable mortgage taxes.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrowers are required to reimburse the Bank for all reasonable legal fees, filing fees, recording fees, and other costs incurred by the Bank related to the negotiation and closing of this amendment within ten days of receiving an invoice.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard reimbursement clause in a loan amendment. The requirement is limited to 'reasonable' fees and costs, which provides a standard level of protection against excessive charges.
obligations: Borrower must reimburse the Bank for reasonable legal fees, filing fees, recording fees, and other costs incurred in connection with the First Amendment
Borrower must make payment within ten (10) days of receipt of an invoice
rights: Bank has the right to be reimbursed for reasonable costs and expenses incurred in connection with the transaction
deadlines: Within ten (10) days of receipt of an invoice

clauses.heading: 14. Ratification. The remaining terms, provisions and conditions
clauses.text: set forth in the Existing Loan Agreement shall remain in full force and effect as long as any Indebtedness of the Borrower is owing to the Bank and/or the Revolver Commitment remains in effect. The Borrower adopts, restates, confirms and ratifies the warranties, covenants and representations set forth in the Existing Loan Agreement (except the representations and warranties that specify a specific date or period of time) and further represents to the Bank that, as of the date hereof, no Default or Event of Default exists under the Loan Agreement (including this First Amendment). All references to the "Loan Agreement" appearing in any of the Loan Documents shall hereafter be deemed references to the Existing Loan Agreement as amended, modified and supplemented by this First Amendment.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower confirms that the original loan agreement remains active and valid. The Borrower also reaffirms their previous promises and legal statements, while confirming that they are currently not in default of the loan agreement as amended by this document.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard ratification and reaffirmation clause common in loan amendments. It ensures the continuity of the original agreement and requires the borrower to confirm their ongoing compliance, which is standard practice for lenders.
obligations: Borrower must adopt, restate, confirm and ratify the warranties, covenants and representations set forth in the Existing Loan Agreement
Borrower must represent that no Default or Event of Default exists as of the date of the amendment

clauses.heading: 4 Amendment and the terms of the Existing Loan Agreement, the t
clauses.text: terms of this First Amendment shall control and govern, and the agreements shall be interpreted so as to carry out and give full effect to the intent of this First Amendment. Each Borrower and the Bank hereby adopt, ratify and confirm the Loan Agreement, as amended hereby, and acknowledge and agree that the Loan Agreement and all other Loan Documents, are and remain in full force and effect. Borrower acknowledges and agrees that its liabilities and obligations under the Loan Agreement and all other Loan Documents, including the Security Instruments, are not impaired in any respect by this First Amendment. Original Borrower further ratifies and confirms the mortgage liens and security interests granted thereby pursuant to Article III of the Existing Loan Agreement and hereby grants and regrants such mortgage liens and security interests in favor of the Bank.
clauses.plain_english: The parties agree that this amendment governs the relationship, and they reaffirm that the original loan agreement and all related security documents remain valid and enforceable. The borrowers confirm that their existing obligations and the bank's security interests (mortgage liens) remain fully in effect.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard ratification and confirmation clause found in loan amendments to ensure the continuity of the original agreement and security interests. It does not introduce new, unusual, or one-sided risks.
obligations: Borrower and Bank must interpret agreements to give effect to the intent of the First Amendment
Borrower must maintain liabilities and obligations under the Loan Agreement and Security Instruments
Original Borrower must grant and regrant mortgage liens and security interests in favor of the Bank
rights: Bank retains mortgage liens and security interests
cross_references: Article III of the Existing Loan Agreement

clauses.heading: 15. SUBMISSION TO JURISDICTION. BORROWER AND THE BANK HEREBY
clauses.text: CONSENT TO THE JURISDICTION OF ANY OF THE LOCAL, STATE, AND FEDERAL COURTS LOCATED WITHIN TULSA COUNTY, OKLAHOMA AND WAIVES ANY OBJECTION WHICH THE BORROWER MAY HAVE BASED ON IMPROPER VENUE OR FORUM NON CONVENIENS TO THE CONDUCT OF ANY PROCEEDING IN ANY SUCH COURT.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower and the Bank agree that any legal disputes will be handled in the courts of Tulsa County, Oklahoma. The Borrower also agrees they cannot argue that Tulsa County is an inconvenient or improper place for these legal proceedings.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard forum selection clause. While it limits the Borrower to a specific venue, it is common in commercial loan agreements and does not impose unreasonable or unconscionable burdens.
obligations: Borrower must submit to the jurisdiction of courts in Tulsa County, Oklahoma
Borrower must waive objections based on improper venue or forum non conveniens
rights: Bank and Borrower have the right to initiate proceedings in Tulsa County, Oklahoma courts

clauses.heading: 16. WAIVER OF JURY TRIAL. BORROWER FULLY, VOLUNTARILY AND
clauses.text: EXPRESSLY WAIVES ANY RIGHT TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION OR PROCEEDING TO ENFORCE OR DEFEND ANY RIGHTS UNDER THE LOAN AGREEMENT (INCLUDING THIS FIRST AMENDMENT), THE SECURITY INSTRUMENTS OR UNDER ANY AMENDMENT, SUPPLEMENT, INSTRUMENT, DOCUMENT OR AGREEMENT DELIVERED (OR WHICH MAY IN THE FUTURE BE DELIVERED) IN CONNECTION HEREWITH OR ARISING FROM ANY BANKING RELATIONSHIP EXISTING IN CONNECTION WITH THIS AGREEMENT. THE BORROWER AGREES THAT ANY SUCH ACTION OR PROCEEDING SHALL BE TRIED BEFORE A COURT AND NOT BEFORE A JURY.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower agrees to give up their right to a jury trial for any legal disputes related to the loan agreement or the banking relationship, meaning any such cases will be decided by a judge instead.
clauses.risk_justification: Waiver of jury trial is a standard provision in commercial loan agreements but represents a significant waiver of a fundamental legal right, which is classified as a red flag pattern in the provided KB.
obligations: Borrower must waive the right to a trial by jury in any action or proceeding related to the loan agreement or banking relationship.
Borrower must ensure any such action or proceeding is tried before a court and not before a jury.

clauses.heading: 17. Governing Law. The Loan Agreement (including the First Amendm
clauses.text: ent) shall be deemed to have been made or incurred under the Laws of the State of Oklahoma and shall be construed and enforced in accordance with and governed by the Laws of Oklahoma.
clauses.plain_english: This clause states that the Loan Agreement and its amendments are governed by and interpreted according to the laws of the State of Oklahoma.
clauses.risk_justification: Governing law clauses are standard boilerplate in loan agreements. Oklahoma law is a predictable and standard jurisdiction for commercial contracts, presenting minimal risk.

clauses.heading: 18. Release. In consideration of the amendments contained herein,
clauses.text: Borrower hereby waives and releases Bank from any and all claims and defenses, known or unknown, as of the effective date of this First Amendment, with respect to the Loan Agreement (including this First Amendment) and the Loan Documents and the transactions contemplated thereby.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower agrees to give up any legal claims or defenses it may have against the Bank regarding the loan agreement and related documents up to the date of this amendment.
clauses.risk_justification: This clause constitutes a broad waiver of all legal claims and defenses, including unknown ones, which significantly limits the Borrower's legal recourse against the Bank. This falls under the 'Waiver of important legal rights' red flag pattern.
obligations: Borrower must waive and release Bank from all claims and defenses known or unknown as of the effective date

clauses.heading: 19. Counterparts. This First Amendment may be executed in multipl
clauses.text: counterparts, each of which, when so executed, shall constitute an original copy. Transmission by facsimile or electronic transmission (e.g., pdf format) of an executed counterpart of this First Amendment by any party shall be deemed to constitute due and sufficient delivery of such counterpart and such facsimile or electronic transmission shall be deemed to be an original counterpart of this First Amendment.
clauses.plain_english: This agreement can be signed in separate copies, which together form one complete document. Sending a signed copy via fax or email (such as a PDF) is legally recognized as a valid delivery of an original document.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard boilerplate 'counterparts' clause that facilitates execution and delivery of the agreement. It carries no significant legal or financial risk.
rights: Parties may execute the agreement in multiple counterparts
Parties may deliver the agreement via facsimile or electronic transmission

clauses.text:
s of this
First Amendment and ratifies and affirms its obligations under, and acknowledges,
renews and extends its continued liability under, each Loan Document to which it is a
party, and agrees that each Loan Document to which it is a party remains in full force
and effect.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower confirms that all existing loan agreements remain valid and binding, and they continue to be responsible for all obligations and liabilities under those agreements.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard reaffirmation clause commonly found in loan amendments to ensure continuity of debt obligations. It does not create new liabilities but confirms existing ones.
obligations: Borrower must ratify and affirm its obligations under each Loan Document to which it is a party.
Borrower must acknowledge, renew, and extend its continued liability under each Loan Document to which it is a party.

negotiation_points.issue: Ambiguous Language: The clause imposes an immediate Event of Default for failure to satisfy a condition subsequent (North Dakota registration) by a specific date without further notice, creating significant operational risk for the Borrower.
negotiation_points.leverage: The clause imposes an immediate Event of Default for failure to satisfy a condition subsequent (North Dakota registration) by a specific date without further notice, creating significant operational risk for the Borrower.

negotiation_points.issue: Ambiguous Language: The clause imposes a mandatory fee based on a percentage of the total commitment amount upon the Borrower's request for an amendment. While standard in commercial lending, the fee is calculated on the total commitment rather than the actual usage, which can be costly for the Borrower.

negotiation_points.issue: Ambiguous Language: This clause imposes a mandatory, recurring principal reduction obligation on the Borrower, which increases liquidity pressure. recommended_actions: Review the 'Release' clause (Clause 21) as it constitutes a high-risk waiver of all claims and defenses against the Bank.
Ensure the 'Conditions Precedent' (Clause 14) are fully satisfied, specifically the delivery of North Dakota qualification certificates, to avoid default on the amendment effectiveness.
Evaluate the financial impact of the Quarterly Commitment Reduction (QCR) of $150,000 per quarter to ensure liquidity for principal payments.
Clarify the 'sole discretion' language in the amendment fee provision (Clause 8) to define objective criteria for when such fees are triggered.
Verify that the Guarantor has provided the necessary consolidated financial statements to support the Minimum Leverage and Interest Coverage ratios.
